The withholding regulations define 'פוליסה משתתפת ברווחים' separately, as a savings plan in a life policy approved by the insurance supervisor as profit-sharing (TXA-04). The INS Terms table calls this the legal category of savings policies and 'modern' executive policies; which executive-policy cohorts are profit-sharing is not set out, hence 'חלק'. 'תיק משתתף ברווחים' is the insurer's portfolio behind these policies (CMA reports), not the policy.
